svg.title: Stone Code · Flint Golan 01
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction based on Maayan Magenheim’s annotated guide. The code excerpt comes from the original image.

div.div: Source file, number of vertices and faces, height statistics, entropy and a SHA-256 fingerprint of the height-data stream.
Normalized heights (0–1) are multiplied by 255 and stored as bytes. Each byte is written as two hexadecimal digits: 00–FF. Brighter green represents greater height.
The index of the first byte in each row. These positions are written in hexadecimal.
Valid height samples are arranged as one continuous stream, then divided into rows of 48 bytes for display. A row is not a contour of the stone.
XOR combines the bytes in a row into one byte. Its eight bits are shown as blocks; lit blocks represent 1. Brightness varies with the resulting value.
Each byte is also mapped to a visual symbol. The symbols are another representation of the numbers, not a decoded secret.
Vector reconstruction based on Maayan Magenheim’s annotated guide. The code excerpt comes from the original image.
